values.key-finding: Shift managers plan the week on paper first, then copy it into the app on Monday morning.
values.full-notes:
Paper is faster when plans change a lot during the week. The app is where the plan becomes official and the team sees it.

- Wants to see last week’s plan while making this one
- Prints the final plan for the break room

values.observations: Found the invoice list straight away, but looked for the download button at the top of the page, not in each row. Needed a hint after a minute.
follow-ups: [ ] Try a download button above the list
[ ] Test with two more people before deciding

values.summary: The date picker now opens on the selected month, not today’s, and the week can start on Monday or Sunday.
values.migration-notes: Nothing to change for most teams. If you set the first day of the week yourself, use the new weekStart setting instead.
